homepage.body:
HOME REPORTS ABOUT CONTACT NEWSLETTER
☰ HOME REPORTS ABOUT CONTACT NEWSLETTER
Scroll
 
 
 
 

ALL THE NUMBERS YOU NEED

 

DataReportal offers thousands of free reports that help you make sense of what people are really doing online.

 
 
 

Featured Reports

 

Digital 2027 Global Overview Report

Our latest flagship report, with 900+ pages exploring global digital adoption and use. Top stories include surging AI use, a decline in the use of the web, evolving search behaviours, new dynamics in the purchase journey, and the return of an old favourite.

Read more →

Digital 2027 Local Country Headlines

A handy collection of all the latest local market data, with essential headlines for digital adoption and use in almost every country in the world. Includes headline figures for the use of mobile phones, internet adoption, and social media use.

Read more →

 
ADVERTISEMENT
 

Digital 2026 Mid-Year Global Update Report

Our global update report for April 2026, with 600+ pages exploring digital adoption and use around the world. Top stories include startling trends for AI adoption and use, a closer look at how people use search and AI, and strong growth in social media use.

Read more →

Digital 2026 Global Overview Report

Our flagship report from last year, with 700 pages exploring global digital adoption and use. Top stories include big new milestones for use of the internet, social media, and AI, along with insights into social platform preferences and the use of search engines.

Read more →

 

Quick Search

No results found

Alternatively, click here to browse all reports.

 

GLOBAL OVERVIEWS

Essential global and regional insights, with comparisons across key economies.

Explore →

LOCAL INSIGHTS

In-depth local findings for more than 230 countries and territories around the world.

Explore →

SPECIALIST REPORTS

Data and trends for specific topics, with regional overviews and local insights.

Explore →
 

SELECTED CONTENT

 

DIGITAL 2024 GLOBAL NEWS REPORT

A closer look at the world’s evolving news preferences, including detailed examination of the role that social media platforms play in today’s news landscape. Compares data from a variety of trusted sources, offering valuable perspectives on this crucial aspect of the online world.

JAPAN’S DIGITAL DIFFERENCES

A closer look at why digital behaviours in Japan are so different to those that we see almost everywhere else in the world. Includes valuable insights into Japan’s digital evolution, and explores what the latest trends tell us today’s connected behaviours.

 
 
Newsletter Block
This newsletter signup form needs a storage option. Edit the block and enter a storage location via the Storage tab.

GET INSIGHTS IN YOUR INBOX

Don’t worry, we hate spam too. We won’t share your details with anyone else.
Please read our privacy policy for full details.

Thank you! You’ll receive a confirmation email from us shortly. Please click on the button in that email to confirm your subscription, otherwise we won’t be able to send you updates.

 

Latest Reports

All the data, insights, and trends you need to help you make sense of the “state of digital” in Zimbabwe in 2027, including detailed statistics for internet use, social media preferences, and mobile use, as well as user numbers for all the top social platforms.

All the data, insights, and trends you need to help you make sense of the “state of digital” in Vietnam in 2027, including detailed statistics for internet use, AI adoption and use, ecommerce activity, social media use, and mobile use, as well as user numbers for all the top social platforms.

All the data, insights, and trends you need to help you make sense of the “state of digital” in Venezuela in 2027, including detailed statistics for internet use, social media preferences, and mobile use, as well as user numbers for all the top social platforms.
